thread:
maria: Quick check-in on the battlecard iteration for next week's webinar. Need crisp one-liners vs cloud AI, LLM APIs, infra vendors + routing rules for inbound leads. Keep replies short.

devon: i'll post three suggested headers and a tiny rebuttal set.

alex: headers look good. For messaging, highlight: predictable p99, rollout controls, and per-token cost visibility.

maria: Draft headers:
```
- Core claim: "Production inference that scales predictably: lower surprises, better SLOs."
- Cloud platforms: "Scale & breadth, we deliver predictable per-request economics and smarter routing."
- LLM APIs: "Instant integration plus enterprise controls for rollouts & model pinning."
- Infra vendors: "Managed control plane + runtime so you don't rebuild observability and batching."
```

sarah: Love the last line. For the cloud line, can we add a short metric teaser? e.g., "we reduced p95 variance by X% in internal tests" (legal will vet).

maria: Yes we'll add a vetted number in the appendix. devon: your rebuttals?

devon: Quick rebuttals:
- "Cloud is simpler" -> "True for small scale. At production scale you want routing, rollouts, and cost transparency 1"
- "APIs are fastest" -> "We mirror SDK ergonomics and add platform controls so devs don't hit surprises in production."
- "We'll self-host" -> "Open runtimes lack integrated observability, KV-cache sharing, and managed fallback policies."

alex: For webinar slides: two must-have visuals: 1) Competitive matrix (rows: latency SLOs, cost control, rollout tools, deployment options, observability) 2) Tech flow: request -> routing -> model variant -> fallback -> cache hit path.

maria: Routing rules for inbound leads:
- Keywords: "SLA", "dedicated", "enterprise" -> AE-enterprise
- Keywords: "benchmarks", "cost comparison" -> product-marketing + growth-sdr
- Keywords: "on-prem", "air-gapped", "vpc" -> solutions-eng + security
- Keywords: "trial", "POC", "sandbox" -> growth-sdr

devon: routing-bot can handle. I'll add patterns to Intercom.

routing-bot: added rule draft to the routing doc. scheduled push to Intercom tomorrow. :gear:

tyler: Social copy suggestion for the webinar: "Worried about inference surprises? Join to see side-by-side benchmarks and the routing patterns production teams use. Register: <link>"

maria: Good. Also add an email variant focused on "benchmarks pack" CTA. We'll A/B test.

alex: Ownership & deadlines:
- Benchmarks & vetted numbers: alex + eng-runtime by Thu EOD
- Slides + comp matrix: devon + sarah by Fri 11am
- Routing automation: devon + routing-bot by Fri 5pm
- Email + social variants: tyler by Fri 3pm

maria: Thanks. I've uploaded the draft battlecard doc. Please leave inline comments. We'll lock on Monday morning.
